title: Claude Sheets Beta (2026): Check Claude's Math in the Cells
description:
Claude Sheets beta, explained in 60 seconds: since November 10, 2026, on paid plans, Claude Sheets is a spreadsheet inside Claude where you and Claude edit the same cells; Claude can add tabs, write formulas that work across tabs, apply formatting and conditional formatting, and add dropdowns, checkboxes, and charts.
Anthropic says formulas stay in the cells, so you can see and check how each number was calculated; Claude's edits are outlined as they land, and when Claude finishes, a card can undo just that change; it goes a few seconds after you're back in the sheet, or as soon as you work in the cells, and after that version history restores an earlier version, which also removes edits made after it.
The Claude Help Center says it's on by default on Team plans, and on Enterprise plans it's off by default until it's turned on in Organization settings > Artifacts.

Anthropic's launch post first: https://claude.com/resources/articles/sheets-whiteboards-data

Our example (illustration, not Anthropic's numbers): a hiring budget by team and quarter, 3 teams and 4 quarters. The prompt "Make a hiring budget by team and quarter." is Anthropic's own example; the 3 team totals, the "3 totals with no formula" meter and the "ALL 3 HAVE FORMULAS" tick are ours. Before, in our example, we pasted the table into another tool, where our 3 totals were plain numbers with no formula, so checking one meant redoing the math. Now, in our example, each total is a formula you can check. Anthropic gives no counts; "ALL 3" means our example sheet, not that Claude writes every number as a formula.

What Anthropic says. On what it is: "Claude Sheets is a spreadsheet built into Claude. Ask for a tracker, budget, or model, and Claude builds a working sheet that you, your team, and Claude can edit together." On the same cells: "A sheet is an artifact that you and Claude edit in the same cells. Claude can add tabs, write formulas that work across tabs, apply formatting and conditional formatting, and add dropdowns, checkboxes, and charts." On formulas: "Formulas stay in the cells, so you can see and check how each number was calculated." A formula shows how a number was calculated; it does not prove the inputs or the formula right.

On edits and Undo: "When Claude changes a sheet, each edit is outlined as it lands, so you can see what changed." "When Claude finishes, a card says what Claude updated. If it shows “Undo,” select it to take back only that change. The card goes away a few seconds after you’re back in the sheet, or as soon as you work in the cells. After that, use Version history to restore an earlier version, which also removes edits made after it."

Before and now: "Working with Claude on a project often meant moving the output over to another tool or program, where Claude didn’t have live access to follow progress and changes." "Now, your documents, boards, sheets, and dashboards can stay in Claude, with access for your team to continue editing together."

Where and when: "Claude Sheets is available in beta on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, and Enterprise plans. It’s on by default on Team plans. On Enterprise plans, it’s off by default until it’s turned on in Organization settings > Artifacts." The launch post is dated November 10, 2026 ("Today we’re launching Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets in beta").

Limits: "For now, sheets have simple spreadsheet functionality, but we are working on adding more." The help page lists as not supported "Macros, VBA, Power Query, DAX, and print layout." and says "Sheets can’t pull live data from connected apps". "Claude Sheets counts toward your plan’s usage limits, like the rest of your work with Claude."

The story: a maths test. Before, our pasted table was like a test handed in with answers only; now its working sits in the cells, and you check it like a teacher with a pencil. The mascot, the robot and the pictures are our drawings, made from code, not Anthropic's artwork or logos.

Sources
[A] Anthropic, "Introducing Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data" (November 10, 2026): https://claude.com/resources/articles/sheets-whiteboards-data
[B] Claude Help Center, "Get started with Claude Sheets" (page read November 26, 2026): https://support.claude.com/en/articles/18324300

Voice: an AI clone of the creator's voice (Chatterbox, MIT license; the audio carries an AI watermark). Animation rendered from code.
